The '''Hidden Tegoor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hidden Tegoor]].
